query: with lesson_audit as (select s.name as series_name,l.title as lesson_title,coalesce(length(btrim(l.content)),0) as content_length,l.is_active as lesson_active,(select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id=l.id) as exercise_count,(select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id=l.id and e.is_published=false and e.is_active=false) as draft_exercise_count,(select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id=l.id) as quiz_count,(select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id=l.id and q.is_published=false and q.is_active=false) as draft_quiz_count from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id=l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id=c.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id=o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id=o.level_id join public.series s on s.id=o.series_id where sub.name='Sciences de la Vie et de la Terre' and lv.name='Terminale' and s.name in ('A1','A2') and ((c.title='Thème 1 : L’origine de la vie et l’évolution de la lignée humaine.' and l.title='Leçon 2 : L’évolution de la lignée humaine.') or (c.title='Thème 2 : La transmission des caractères héréditaires chez l’Homme.' and l.title in ('Leçon 1 : L’hérédité du sexe et du groupe sanguin chez l’Homme.','Leçon 2 : Les prévisions génétiques.')))), citation_audit as (select sub.name as subject_name,count(*) as citation_count,count(distinct ct.theme) as distinct_notions,count(*) filter (where c.is_active=false and c.is_validated=false) as draft_citation_count from public.citations c join public.subjects sub on sub.id=c.subject_id left join public.citation_themes ct on ct.citation_id=c.id where c.created_at >= now() - interval '30 minutes' and sub.name in ('Français','Philosophie','Histoire-Géographie','Physique-Chimie') group by sub.name) select 'lessons' as audit_type,json_agg(lesson_audit order by series_name,lesson_title) as result from lesson_audit union all select 'citations' as audit_type,json_agg(citation_audit order by subject_name) as result from citation_audit;
